cases.name: Username rejects invalid characters

cases.name: Enter submits the demo login
cases.expected_result: Enter in the password field publishes the fixed demo-only login status.

cases.expected_result: Login reset empties both credentials and the prior result.

steps: Login reset preserves independent search state
cases.expected_result: Login reset preserves the existing search query.

cases.expected_result: The toggle reveals then masks the password without changing its value.

cases.name: Enter submits search
cases.expected_result: Enter publishes the literal no-results message for sample book.

cases.name: Search reset clears query and result
steps: Search reset clears query and result
cases.expected_result: Search reset empties the query and previous result.

steps: Search enforces its input length limit

cases.expected_result: Markup is displayed literally in the result and creates no image element.

cases.name: Email rejects malformed addresses

cases.name: Required agreement blocks submission
cases.expected_result: Unchecked required agreement has valueMissing=true and prevents a result.

cases.expected_result: Checking then unchecking updates the agreement checkbox state.

cases.expected_result: Selecting express delivery unchecks standard delivery.

cases.expected_result: Selecting Turkey retains the tr option value.

cases.name: Notes retain multiple lines
cases.expected_result: The textarea preserves both entered lines and their newline.

cases.name: Quantity rejects values below minimum
cases.expected_result: Quantity 0 has rangeUnderflow=true.

cases.name: Quantity rejects values above maximum
cases.expected_result: Quantity 11 has rangeOverflow=true.

cases.name: Quantity rejects a fractional step
cases.expected_result: Quantity 1.5 has stepMismatch=true for integer steps.

cases.name: Quantity accepts an in-range integer
cases.expected_result: Quantity 5 has valid=true.

cases.name: Disabled input rejects editing
cases.expected_result: Disabled input rejects fill and preserves its initial value.

cases.name: Read-only input rejects editing
cases.expected_result: Read-only input rejects fill and preserves its initial value.

cases.name: Reset restores native control defaults
cases.expected_result: Reset restores unchecked agreement, standard delivery, gb, quantity 1, and empty notes.

cases.name: Invalid submission leaves result empty
cases.expected_result: Empty email prevents submission and leaves the result empty.
